text: D1b: the cheaper judge for the hardest version, two scrambled alphabets; does one search find as many hidden messages as ten?
96 planted messages, 6 scrambled copies each, ten searches per text, every search's best kept; 180 s per text for ten.
One search finds 63, ten find 71: one is not enough; four (66) are within 5. Power the same at 13 and 16 (30 and 33 of 48 at one search).
